# MCP servers

<!-- Generated by apply.mjs. Do not edit; change .ruler folders and rerun it. -->

Last regenerated: 2026-11-25 19:45 (UTC+01:00).

Like skills, MCP servers add up: a session started in a domain folder gets the shared servers plus that domain's. Define a shared server only in the root `.ruler/ruler.toml`. The description comes from the comment line directly above each server in `ruler.toml`.

## shared (1)

Sessions get these wherever they start. Defined in `.ruler/ruler.toml`.

| Server | Connects to | What it's for | Agents |
|---|---|---|---|
| context7 | https://mcp.context7.com/mcp | Library and framework docs, looked up on demand. | all |

## game-development (1)

Sessions started in `game-development/` get these plus the shared ones. Defined in `game-development/.ruler/ruler.toml`.

| Server | Connects to | What it's for | Agents |
|---|---|---|---|
| godot | `npx -y @coding-solo/godot-mcp` | Godot: launch the editor, run the game and read its debug output, edit scenes. | all |

## web-development (2)

Sessions started in `web-development/` get these plus the shared ones. Defined in `web-development/.ruler/ruler.toml`.

| Server | Connects to | What it's for | Agents |
|---|---|---|---|
| Neon | https://mcp.neon.tech/mcp | Neon Postgres: projects, branches, SQL and migrations. | all |
| cloudflare-api | https://mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp | The whole Cloudflare API: Workers, R2, DNS, logs and more. | all |
